## 1. Mission & Epistemic Contract

`unsolved-mathematics` is a version-controlled, machine-readable research atlas of **120 open mathematical problems** paired with:
1. A **single-source YAML registry** (`data/problems.yaml`, validated strictly against `schema/problem.schema.json`).
2. **120 structured 7-section dossiers** (`problems/<slug>/{README,history,originator,approaches,attempts,papers,mathematicians,status}.md`) plus 120 AI-assisted working syntheses (`meta-analyses/<slug>.md`).
3. A **deterministic BM25 retrieval corpus** (`rag/corpus.jsonl`, globally unique chunk IDs, zero optional tokenizer drift).
4. A **primary-source citation & retraction audit** (`scripts/verify_citations.py`, `data/citation-verification-log.json`, `scripts/check_retractions.py`, `data/retraction-audit.json`): **646** identifier-bearing rows checked live against `export.arxiv.org` and `api.crossref.org` (`network_error: 0`), yielding **537 API-verified identifiers** (strict 1-to-1 bijection with every `verified` row across all 120 `papers.md` tables, zero duplicates, zero bare arXiv IDs) and **109 invalid/hallucinated identifiers historically stripped** to `—` / `needs-verification`; all **287 verified DOIs** checked against Crossref + DataCite retraction notices (**0 retracted**, **3 publisher errata/corrections** logged, `network_errors: 0`).
5. A **daily full external research-program mirror & unified offline search** (`scripts/sync_external_programs.py`, `scripts/search_all_problems.py`, `data/external/lefttosolve/`, `.github/workflows/sync-external.yml`): mirrors **all 26 Left to Solve research programs (62,790 targets)** across 27 `<4 MiB` JSONL shards (zero statement excerpts, CC BY-SA carved out), with `solved_by_kind` disaggregation (`open: 326, known: 1,322, warmup: 161`, raising 4 unverified agent-claim review signals) and a deterministic `114/120` crosswalk (`docs/external/CROSSWALK.md`) that never alters `data/problems.yaml`.
6. A **standalone, zero-Mathlib Lean 4.35.0 formal core** (`lean/`, `autoImplicit = false`, commit `eb6cafb7`) proving **69 headline structural theorems** across **8 open-problem domains** (Collatz 31 incl. Fine–Wilf Odd-Unit-Lock spine valuation ceiling, 2-adic isometry, exhaustive $d \le 7$ & unconditional 1-/2-/3-odd-step positive-cycle exclusion for all $d \ge 1$, sharp universal affine intercept ceiling, Eliahou–Steiner cycle amplitude ceiling, catalytic cylinder; Erdős–Straus 5; **complete Lonely Runner $n \le 3$** 8; Brocard 7; Primes/Twins 4; Goldbach 3; Odd Perfect/Mersenne 7 incl. **Complete Euclid–Euler biconditional theorem** & **Euler's 1750 Mersenne divisor congruence $2p \mid (q-1)$**; and **exact Ramsey $R(3,3)=6$ & $R(3,4)=9$** 4), paired with **18 concrete non-vacuity witnesses** (`lean/NonVacuity.lean`), **22 explicit adversarial false-variant refutations** (`lean/Adversarial.lean`) = **109 audited declarations** (16 zero-axiom), and a live 3-case negative kernel rejection test (`scripts/test_lean_negative.py`), with **0 `sorry`, 0 `admit`, 0 `native_decide`, 0 custom `axiom` in proof modules** (`lean/Challenge.lean` holds the 69 `sorry`-stated comparator specifications by design), axioms strictly within `{propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound}` (`lean/VerifyAxioms.lean`, mirrored verbatim in `README.md`), challenge/solution comparator (`lean/comparator.json`), human-auditable statement fidelity (`lean/STATEMENT_FIDELITY.md`), and full 6-kernel replay (`lean/six_kernel_audit.txt`).
7. A **catalytic native Collatz accelerator** (`problems/collatz-conjecture/native/`: C17/BMI2 `collatz_catalytic.c`, zero-`unsafe` Rust cross-oracle `collatz_catalytic_oracle.rs`, 250k ASan/UBSan fuzzer `fuzz_collatz_catalytic.c`, `docs/benchmarks.md`, `docs/COLLATZ-TOOLSTACK-AND-CATALYTIC-AUDIT.md`) delivering **1,683×–7,137×** verified speedups, `4,096 B` fixed-stack DFS through $d=34$, and exact Odd-Unit-Lock target-tail extension through $t \le 26$ (`884.4M` pairs).
8. A **publication-grade AMS-LaTeX white paper** (`paper/Donahue_2026_unsolved_mathematics_atlas.tex` → `paper/Donahue_2026_unsolved_mathematics_atlas.pdf` + clean-room-verified `paper/arxiv_submission.tar.gz`), **FAIR metadata** (`ro-crate-metadata.json`, `croissant.json`), **dual DigiCert RFC 3161 + Bitcoin OpenTimestamps manifest proofs** (`data/MANIFEST.sha256.tsr`, `data/MANIFEST.sha256.ots`), Software Heritage archival (`swh:1:snp:c11ec8263dd64b986c52bb400b8c3a85a3e6a254`), `docs/LITERATURE_AND_EXPORT_CONTROL.md`, and live GitHub Pages **Atlas Explorer, 8-Domain Proof Blueprint & External Programs Mirror** (`https://0thernes.github.io/unsolved-mathematics/`).

**Hard Epistemic Invariants:**
- Never claim any open conjecture is solved without primary-source mathematical consensus.
- Never fabricate a DOI, arXiv ID, metric, test result, or review record.
- Never cite `0thernes LLC` (no legal entity exists as of November 2026); use `Alexander S. Donahue` (independent researcher, ORCID `0009-0006-8168-9648`).
- Disclose transparently that only 1/4 planned AI model passes (Claude self-review on 2026-06-14, recorded under the historical non-canonical session label `claude-opus-4-8`) ran across the original 106 meta-analyses, all four AI panels remain `pending` on the 14 dossiers added in `v0.8.0`, and 0/120 independent human mathematician peer reviews have been completed.
- Commit and push cleanly straight to `main` (Build Standard v1.2.0 R2; no PR templates per R4; classify every finding across all 10 classes per R7).

## 2. Canonical Directory Map

- `VERSION` — single version source (`0.9.0`)
- `ro-crate-metadata.json`, `croissant.json` — FAIR RO-Crate 1.1 & MLCommons Croissant 1.0 descriptors
- `data/problems.yaml` — sole source of truth for the 120 problems
- `schema/problem.schema.json` — mandatory JSON Schema enforced by `scripts/validate.py`
- `data/problems.json` — deterministically generated machine registry (`CURRENT_YEAR = 2026`, tie-break `(-css, slug)`)
- `data/citation-verification-log.json` — full API verification log for all 646 checked identifiers (537 verified)
- `data/retraction-audit.json` — Crossref + DataCite retraction audit across all 287 verified DOIs (0 retracted)
- `data/external/lefttosolve/` — daily sharded metadata mirror of all 26 Left to Solve programs (62,790 items across 27 shards; carved out of CC BY 4.0)
- `data/MANIFEST.sha256` (+ `.tsr`, `.ots`) — SHA-256 tamper-evidence manifest & dual DigiCert RFC 3161 + Bitcoin OpenTimestamps proofs
- `lean/` — standalone 8-domain Lean 4.35.0 formal core (`autoImplicit = false`, `FormalAtlas/{Defs,Collatz,ErdosStraus,LonelyRunner,Brocard,Primes,Goldbach,PerfectNumbers,Ramsey}.lean`, `Challenge.lean`, `Solution.lean`, `NonVacuity.lean`, `Adversarial.lean`, `VerifyAxioms.lean`, `comparator.json`, `STATEMENT_FIDELITY.md`, `six_kernel_audit.txt`)
- `paper/` — AMS-LaTeX white paper (`Donahue_2026_unsolved_mathematics_atlas.tex`, `references.bib`, compiled PDF, `arxiv_submission.tar.gz`)
- `scripts/` — `generate.py`, `validate.py`, `check_dossiers.py`, `check_papers.py`, `proof_claim_sweep.py`, `verify_citations.py`, `check_retractions.py`, `check_readme_axioms.py`, `sync_external_programs.py`, `search_all_problems.py`, `test_lean_negative.py`, `timestamp_manifest.py`, `build_site.py`, `build_indexes.py`, `build_review_register.py`, `build_data_manifest.py`, `Audit-Repo.ps1`, `audit-repo.sh`
- `rag/` — `build_corpus.py`, `retriever.py`, `embed_index.py`, `corpus.jsonl`
- `tests/` — `test_atlas.py`, `test_collatz_instruments.py`, `test_external_programs.py`, `test_verification_ladder.py`, `test_properties.py`, `mutation_check.py`
- `CLAIMS.md`, `LIMITATIONS.md`, `ERRATA.md`, `REPLICATION.md`, `HARDENING_INDEX.md`
- `docs/CROSS_ATLAS_AUDIT_2026-11-25.md` — Cross-Atlas non-retirement audit (`v2.7.0` frozen snapshot + `v2.10.0` 2,000-problem / 290-crosswalk reconciliation; 0 grand problems retired)
- `docs/reviews/2026-11-25-three-cycle-hardening-audit.md` — full multi-cycle, 10-class hardening audit
- `docs/adr/0001–0003` — Architecture Decision Records

## 3. Verification Commands

```bash
python scripts/generate.py --check
python scripts/validate.py
python scripts/check_dossiers.py --strict
python scripts/check_papers.py
python scripts/proof_claim_sweep.py
python scripts/check_retractions.py --check
python scripts/check_readme_axioms.py
python scripts/sync_external_programs.py --check
python scripts/build_data_manifest.py --check
python scripts/timestamp_manifest.py --check
python scripts/test_lean_negative.py
python -m pytest -v tests/
python tests/mutation_check.py
cd lean && lake build Challenge Solution NonVacuity Adversarial && lake env lean VerifyAxioms.lean
# Linux CI with bubblewrap:
cd lean && lake check --paranoid && lake comparator --config comparator.json --paranoid
```
